facts.statement: Patient data including names, dates of birth, and diagnosis codes was shared and forwarded to offshore staff in Pune prior to the execution of the governing BAA.
facts.quote: Kevin Brooks (their data eng manager) emailed a "sample extract" on 12 Sep so we could size the pipeline. Pranav opened it here and forwarded to Sneha and Vikram in Pune to start profiling. "It's real data I think — names, DOBs, some diagnosis codes."
facts.whyItMatters: Regulated patient data (PHI) has been transferred to offshore personnel while the BAA (which reportedly prohibits offshore access) is still in review and unsigned.

facts.statement: The Harrington BAA contains a restrictive clause prohibiting the handling of patient data by personnel outside the United States.
facts.quote: the BAA says nobody outside the US touches patient data
facts.whyItMatters: This requirement necessitates the hire of Daniel Ortiz and contradicts the recent data sharing with the team in Pune.

facts.statement: Daniel Ortiz is being hired as a US-based freelancer specifically to address Harrington's data residency requirements.
facts.quote: US-based, so the offshore thing is solved
facts.whyItMatters: The contractor's location is a material condition for compliance with the Harrington project's data security requirements.

facts.statement: The Harrington MSA and BAA must be finalized and signed by the start of October.
facts.quote: Rebecca needs MSA + BAA by 1 Oct.
facts.whyItMatters: Sets the deadline for the primary agreements that the contractor's engagement supports.

facts.statement: The Harrington BAA requires a cyber insurance policy limit that is significantly higher than the current coverage.
facts.quote: Our cyber policy is $1M btw, Harrington BAA wants 5.
facts.whyItMatters: A $4M gap exists between current coverage and the client's contractual requirements.

facts.statement: It is unconfirmed whether the existing CareBridge intercompany setup covers the scope of work for this project.
facts.quote: Pranav asked if the CareBridge setup (the intercompany thing) covers this too — Karandeep: "should do, same kind of work." Nobody checked.
facts.whyItMatters: Internal legal structures for staffing and cross-entity work need verification to ensure proper coverage.
